text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: synth-check fired: `synth-us-east-1/canary-03` failing 5xx rate > 20% for 3 consecutive waves (5m window). probe target: public-ingress.redwood.ai -> 503s

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-73421, urgency: high. Paging on-call.

raj.patel: Acked on-call. I'm on it. Can someone drop the latest probe logs?

maria.g: logs from prober attached in the runner -> lots of 503s and a handful of 401s right before spike. Timestamped around 4368887600-4368887640.

alex.k: Seeing a recent deploy to edge-auth service in us-east about 8m ago. Rolling back?

devon: Confirmed deploy at 4368887000 by ci/cd. There was an auth token change (shorter TTL) that didn't land in the prober config.

raj.patel: That would explain 401s then cascade 503s from the gateway when auth fails on downstreams. Quick mitigation: disable the canary prober fanout to us-east until we patch config. Can ops flip the probe routing?

ops-runner: I can pause the prober schedule for canary-03. Pausing now.

ops-runner: paused schedule for synth-us-east-1/canary-03 :white_check_mark:

maria.g: After pause, 5xx rate dropped in synthetic dashboards. Real customer traffic looks stable but a few error spikes reported in latency dashboards from the same region. No direct customer 500s surfaced in error tracker yet.

raj.patel: Good containment. Next: update prober credentials to use new token format, restart prober once validated. Who owns prober config?

devon: devex owns the prober agent image, eng-runtime owns credential handling. I'll coordinate.

eng-runtime: We'll push a config change to prober to accept the new token TTL/format. Doing a canary rollout to a single runner instance for validation.

alex.k: Also recommend a brief rollback of edge-auth to previous version if there's customer impact while we patch prober. Any objections?

sarah_o: From product/support: customers in us-east experiencing slow requests to generation endpoints, a handful of timed-out requests reported to support. Not widespread but visible. Rollback would reduce customer risk.

raj.patel: Let's do a rollback of edge-auth in us-east to previous stable, then re-enable prober after config patch. Devon, ops-runner, coordinate rollback.

ops-runner: Kicking rollback now (edge-auth -> v2.14.3). Rolling back across us-east nodes. ETA ~3m.

ops-runner: rollback complete across us-east :thumbsup:. Monitoring.

maria.g: Dashboards show gateway 5xxs trending down to baseline. Synth 503 spikes reduced.

eng-runtime: We deployed prober config change to one runner instance (canary). Authentication succeeded with new tokens. Preparing rollout to remaining runners.

devon: After we validate, I'll update the prober image tag and schedule resume. Plan: patch -> smoke test -> resume -> monitor 10m.

raj.patel: Sounds good. Update PD incident notes: contained (paused prober) -> rollback edge-auth -> patch prober -> resume. Assign follow-up to eng-runtime and devex for postmortem and a guardrail to prevent token-schema mismatches.

pagerduty-bot: PD-73421 status: acknowledged by raj.patel.

ops-runner: prober resume issued. synth-us-east-1/canary-03 resumed at 4368887688.

maria.g: After resume, synth rates look healthy for the last 2 waves. No reappearing 503 surge.

raj.patel: I'll handoff to next on-call in 20m once we pass a 30m stable window. For now: escalation suppressed for this specific probe group.

eng-runtime: Created follow-up ticket RW-issue-1987: "Prober token format validation + CI gate for auth token schema changes". Assigned to devex + eng-runtime.

sarah_o: Notifying support to close any active tickets once we confirm customer visible errors resolved.

raj.patel: Thanks team. Final note: immediate cause = deploy of edge-auth with token schema change without prober config update. Mitigation = paused prober + rollback + prober patch. Long-term: add pre-release compatibility test and release note gating.

devon: copying the curl we used to smoke test the prober endpoint for docs:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" https://public-ingress.redwood.ai/health/probe-canary-03
```

raj.patel: Closing PD once 30m stable. If anything flares up, reactivate. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: PD-73421 status: resolved by raj.patel at 4368887710."
